verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes inside saved login items, and its documented vaults group those items (e.g. personal vs work), which covers the folders/groups part of the story. One community user found the unexpandable browser pop-up inadequate for managing hundreds of logins, which weighs on how well the extension handles many items. Missing for 10: documented search across TOTP items, service icons, a dedicated TOTP list view or two-tap access to codes, and hands-on corroboration of organizing dozens of tokens.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away

citations.quote: Vaults can be used to organize items — in the example above, we have a vault for personal items and one for work items.
Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
